title: Refunds not received and merchant disputes - support procedure
content: Keep the merchant confirmation and non-sensitive dates for the synthetic review. After verification, inspect the fictional credit entry and ask an agent to reconcile an unresolved refund; no fixed credit date or entitlement is invented.
